turns.question: Is it a frost-free fridge, or a direct-cool one that you defrost by hand?
Is there frost or ice on the back wall inside the freezer or fridge?

fault_name: Excess frost in a manual-defrost unit (needs defrosting)

passages.section: Cause 4: Excessive Frost or Ice Buildup
passages.text: If the freezer compartment has excessive frost or ice buildup, it can prevent the door from sealing properly. Thawing the freezer and removing any excess ice may solve the issue. Ensure that the freezer door is closing properly without any obstructions.
